next.reason: KEPT: 1985 Permanent Error definition, including "Any specified exception procedures are executed" and that it "remains in effect for all subsequent input-output operations on the file unless an implementor-defined technique is invoked", is restated verbatim in §2023:9.1.13.1 ("The permanent error condition remains in effect for all subsequent input-output operations on the file unless an implementor-defined technique is invoked to correct the permanent error condition"); the class-3 values (§2023:9.1.13.6 GR1 "A permanent error exists and no further information is available", 31-39) restate the class. 2023 restates the 1985 class definition word for word in §2023:9.1.13.1 prose, which has no catalog rule; the catalog ids named are the class's status values, each restating it. The persistence sentence lives only in the uncatalogued 9.1.13.1 prose.
